title: Enterprise & Evaluation Tools
summary: This module provides tools for integrating with enterprise platforms, performing AI model evaluations using Patronus, and managing security configurations and tool access filters. It supports both remote and local evaluation methods and enterprise action execution.

nodes.label: Adapt Enterprise Actions
nodes.title: EnterpriseActionKitToolAdapter
nodes.description: Fetches action schemas from an enterprise API and dynamically creates executable tools for agents based on these schemas.

nodes.label: Execute Platform Actions
nodes.title: CrewAIPlatformActionTool
nodes.description: A specialized tool for executing specific actions defined on the CrewAI Platform by making authenticated API calls.

nodes.label: Evaluate with Patronus AI
nodes.title: PatronusEvalTool
nodes.description: Integrates with the Patronus AI evaluation platform to dynamically fetch and apply evaluators and criteria for assessing model inputs/outputs.

nodes.label: Perform Local AI Evaluation
nodes.title: PatronusLocalEvaluatorTool
nodes.description: Enables local evaluation of model inputs and outputs using custom function evaluators provided by a Patronus client.

nodes.label: Evaluate with Predefined Criteria
nodes.title: PatronusPredefinedCriteriaEvalTool
nodes.description: Assesses model inputs and outputs against specific, predefined Patronus evaluation criteria for controlled assessment.

nodes.label: Define Evaluation Interface
nodes.title: BaseEvaluator
nodes.description: An abstract base class that establishes the contract and common interface for all AI model evaluation components.

nodes.label: Run Evaluation Experiments
nodes.title: run_experiment
nodes.description: Orchestrates and executes comprehensive evaluation experiments for agents or crews against a given dataset.

nodes.label: Validate Experiment Outcomes
nodes.title: assert_experiment_successfully
nodes.description: Checks experiment results for failed test cases and compares them against a baseline to detect performance regressions.

nodes.label: Control Tool Access
nodes.title: create_static_tool_filter
nodes.description: Generates a function to filter agent tool usage based on configurable allowlist and blocklist rules, enhancing security.

nodes.label: Manage Security Configuration
nodes.title: SecurityConfig
nodes.description: Handles core security settings for CrewAI components, including the generation and validation of unique component fingerprints.

nodes.label: Patronus API
nodes.title: Patronus AI Evaluation Service
nodes.description: External API for AI model evaluation, providing evaluators and criteria.

nodes.label: Patronus Client
nodes.title: Local Patronus Evaluation Client
nodes.description: A local client library used for performing custom AI model evaluations.

nodes.label: LLM
nodes.title: Large Language Model
nodes.description: An external Large Language Model used by evaluators for their assessment logic.

nodes.label: Tool
nodes.title: Agent Tool
nodes.description: Generic representation of an agent's tool that can be filtered or accessed.

nodes.label: CrewAI Agents
nodes.title: CrewAI Agents
nodes.description: The intelligent agents within the CrewAI framework that utilize tools and security configurations.

groups.label: Enterprise Integration
groups.title: Enterprise Integration
groups.description: Components for integrating CrewAI with enterprise platforms and executing custom actions.

groups.label: AI Model Evaluation
groups.title: AI Model Evaluation
groups.description: Tools and frameworks for evaluating the performance and quality of AI agents and models.

groups.label: Security & Access Control
groups.title: Security & Access Control
groups.description: Manages security configurations and controls access to tools for enhanced system integrity.
